summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology, focused on C++ application software for robotics and autonomous systems. Built and shipped onboard software for a voice-controlled robotic arm—implemented two-link IK in C++, coordinated 5-servo control, and achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) across live hardware runs.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning end-to-end integration of mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and embedded systems.
Designed custom PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented closed-loop sensor feedback over UART and I2C in embedded C.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi Pico and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands.
Implemented a tap-detection algorithm with z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter via software calibration.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a full surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis using image stitching, wavelet denoising, and ZoeDepth depth estimation (±8% error on 3D reconstruction).

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++ and coordinated 5-servo onboard control; resolved 11 integration failures to achieve 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Built autonomy stack: Flask-SocketIO edge server + Jetson+Arduino controller over WebSocket; TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS, dual ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and forward kinematic chains (0T6) for 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt in ROS 2 Humble.
Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place on physical UR5e via UR ROS2 driver; repeatability <2mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD on 5,000+ auto-annotated frames; integrated into ADAS-style autonomy stack with lane-following and waypoint fallback.
Validated in Town02 (30 vehicles, 10 pedestrians); zero collisions and correct traffic light compliance across multiple laps.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Built embedded C++ firmware on STM32 (FreeRTOS, interrupt-driven UART, multi-servo PWM) and used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson for real-time object tracking with STM32 command streaming.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
